page.layout: One printed page: a single column of dictionary entries (Latin headwords in italic with citations), running head "CA." at top centre, page number 93 at top right, catchword "Calle." at bottom right.

main_text.l: Calceamentum] Calceamen, Plin. Calceatus, Suet. Tegmina pedum, Col. Pedalia, Fest. Solea objurgabere rubra, Pers. Cothurnus, calceus utrique pedi aptus, Serv. Phaecasium, Hesych. Sen.
Calceare se] Inducere calceum sibi, vel pedi, Cic.
Calceare equos] Inducere soleas jumentis, Plin. Calceare solea equum, Liv.
Calcitrare] Petere pedibus, Luc. Adversus stimulos calcare, Ter.

Calefacere] Concalefacere aliquem, Cic. Calefactare, Hor. Excalefacere algores, Plin. Incalefacere, Ovid. Fovere, Cic. Confovere oleas, Cat. Refovere, Ovid. Recalfacere, Recalefacere, Ovid. Fovere fomentis calidis, Cels. Tepidare, Plin. Tepefacere, Cic. Temperare ignibus aquam, Hor. Vaporat sol latus montis, Lucr.
Calefactio] Calefactus. Excalefactio, Plin. Focillatio, Fest.

Calefieri] Concalefieri, Varr. Excalefieri, Plin. Percalefieri, Lucr. Fervescere, Id. Corpora concalescunt. Recalescunt motu, Cic. Tepescere; Id. Recalefieri, Scrob. Calescere flamma. Percalescere, Ovid. Intepescere comae radiis, Id.
Calendarium] Fasti. Libri computationem dierum continentes, Serv.
Calidus] Tepens cinis, Stat. Formus, Fest. Formidus, Cato. Vaporeus, Arnob. Vaporosa balnea, Apul. Vaporifera fornax, Stat. Vaporatus, Col. Egelidus, Ovid.
Calet hic] Caletur hic maxime, Plaut. Est hic caloris satis. Est nunc calor foris.

Caliendrum, capilli factitii] Capillamentum, Suet. Externi crines, Prop. Externo tincta colore caput, Id. Captivos miscet Germania crines, Ovid. Captivis comis cultior, Mart. Comis uti emptis, Id. Appositis caput emutare capillis. Coma adulterina, Bud.

page.notes: Scan is slightly skewed; some letters in the italic citations are uncertain (e.g. "Recalefieri", "Scrob."). Lines were printed as a dictionary column; line breaks follow the printed lines loosely. Catchword "Calle." is at the lower right.
